audit_scope.scope_note: The audited commit changes Generator code (canonical diagnostics emission and validation) but does not change generation policy, Reviewer, Solver, Orchestrator, Specification, Taxonomy, or band thresholds.

method.band_logic: PREFERRED if q10 <= value <= q90; WARNING if outside PREFERRED but q05 <= value <= q95; EXTREME if value < q05 or value > q95
method.categorical_percentile_policy: No ordered percentile for correct_span_type, correction_locality, or decision_granularity; report official category count/share and percentile=null.
distance_exclusions: gap_A_B, gap_B_C, and gap_C_D are not included in numeric distance
method.distance_recompute_policy: Recompute from observed item metrics and the official source distribution; do not rely on a stored distance field produced under an invalid zero-stdev assumption.
method.distance_band_relationship: format_distribution_distance is diagnostic only and is not a direct band assignment input.

multiple_comparison_audit.interpretation: The current worst-of-eight rule can turn a single mild gap tail into EXTREME. Multiple-comparison effect is plausible and is close to the nominal independent 8-dimension rate, but official discrete/correlated empirical behavior and non-iid Generator sampling prevent treating the approximation as a formal test.

cause_assessment.target_composition: plausible_contributor; live uses ten distinct targets while pilot repeats targets
cause_assessment.difficulty_composition: not_primary; live has no HARD items and still has higher EXTREME rate
cause_assessment.decision_granularity: composition differs but is not a band input; indirect geometry correlation cannot be excluded
cause_assessment.correction_locality: composition differs but is not a band input; indirect geometry correlation cannot be excluded
cause_assessment.particular_microbatch: pilot EXTREME 010-012 cluster in micro-04; live has one item per distinct microbatch and no shared-context cluster
cause_assessment.canonical_diagnostics_injection_effect: no classification semantics change; patch made diagnostics canonical and fail-closed

pilot_comparison.overall_explanation: The most plausible explanation is small-sample geometry composition plus randomness, with pilot microbatch-04 clustering as a separate pilot-specific factor. Evidence is insufficient to call a persistent Generator geometry bug.

diagnostics_formula.finding: Valid-item format_diagnostics computation unchanged; patch adds canonical injection around it.

quantile_method.finding: nearest_rank_percentile with deterministic mid-rank for ties.

band_assignment.finding: worst_band over the same eight metric bands.

format_distribution_distance.finding: The audited Generator patch preserved the five-metric RMS formula, but the audit corrected the official max-span basis from an erroneous zero-stdev omission to the observed 1.848 mean and 0.7077 sample stdev; this changes diagnostic distances only, not band assignment.

patch_only_behavior: inject_canonical_diagnostics() writes validator-owned diagnostics from sentence/spans/metadata
emit_output.py runs canonicalization before schema validation
missing or unmeasurable diagnostics fail closed instead of being guessed

regression_evidence.missing_diagnostics_fixtures: 3/3 reject before injection; 3/3 pass after canonical injection

canonical_injection_audit.conclusion: The 6/10 live EXTREME result is not explained by the diagnostics emission patch changing band semantics. It is the unchanged band logic applied canonically to fresh live geometry.

human_targeted_sample_audit.note: The three human-visible classifications in this audit are AI provisional only; human review remains authoritative.

decision.recommendation: Do not proceed to 75-item Validation until all six live EXTREME items have completed human review and all required ratings are recorded; proceed only if no blocking human-review finding remains.
rationale: Most live EXTREME direct causes are gap tail deviations, not sentence length, coverage, or unmarked-context collapse.
Several EXTREME items have low official distance percentiles, confirming that a mild gap tail alone can trigger EXTREME.
All six live EXTREME items have format_validity: FAIL and human_review_required: true; reviewing item 004 alone is insufficient.
Pilot/live composition and microbatch differences plausibly explain part of the rate difference.
Canonical injection did not change format classification semantics.
required_next_stage_controls: retain current Generator, Reviewer, Solver, Orchestrator, and band thresholds
report dimension-level tail flags, not only aggregate format band
complete human review for every live EXTREME item before 75-item Validation
block progression if any required live EXTREME review is missing or records a blocking finding
preserve blind human sample fields and record only the three requested human ratings
monitor span profile, gap clustering, and human-visible risk across 75 items
